description: This file is a controller class for customer approval management within the admin section of an OpenCart-based e-commerce platform. It handles displaying approval requests, approving or denying customer or affiliate accounts, and managing related data and views.

classes.name: CustomerApproval
classes.description: Controller class for managing customer approval requests in the admin panel, including listing, approving, and denying customer or affiliate accounts.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method to initialize the customer approval view, load necessary data, and render the approval list page.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Handles AJAX requests to refresh the list of approval requests.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Generates the list of customer approval entries with filtering, pagination, and links for approval/denial actions.

methods.name: approve
methods.description: Processes approval of selected customer or affiliate requests, with permission checks.

methods.name: deny
methods.description: Processes denial of selected customer or affiliate requests, with permission checks.
